description: A bearded man in a tall cap and embroidered robe, holding a short rod, rides a dark horse through a tall wooden gate in a crenellated mudbrick wall. Armoured spearmen with round shields hold the gate on both sides, and torches and fires burn in the background. In the foreground a toppled winged stone bull with a human head lies in the dust. The palette is dark oil-painting browns and orange, with no visible text, border or frame.
